intended_object: An auxiliary open time-window {z : |z.1 − l·τ''_m| < 2⁻²⁴/a_{m−1}} around the l-th time step, used in the proof as the open set on which the pulled flow Jacobian is smooth (inferred from the docstring and the lemmas in the same file).
explanation: This is a proof-internal device, not a standard object. The definition picks out the points whose time coordinate lies within 2⁻²⁴·a_{m−1}⁻¹ of l·τ''_m. The constant is chosen only so that `amnr_short_source_jacobian_product` applies. In the same file, `amnrSourceFlowDomain_isOpen` shows the set is open, `amnr_cutoff_window_mem_sourceFlowDomain` shows it contains each cutoff window, and `amnr_flowGrad_contDiffOn_infty_of_A3` proves the flow Jacobian is smooth on it. It matches its docstring, but no counterpart exists in the literature or in Mathlib.
